test_title: RRB NTPC - UG 2025 (CBT 1) Mid-Range Full Test - 04
subject: general
question: 30 is the result of one fifth of four-fifth of 150 percent of a number x. Determine the 80% of the very same number.
solution:
**Given:**

30 is the result of one fifth of four-fifth of 150 percent of a number x. 

**Calculation:**

30 = (1/5) × (4/5) × (150%) × x

⇒ 30 = (4/25) × (150/100) × x

⇒ 30 = (4/25) × (3/2) × x

⇒ 30 × 25 / 2 = 3x

⇒ 375 = 3x

x = 125

To determine 80% of the same number

80% of 125 = 0.8 x 125 = 100

**Therefore, 80% of the same number is 100.**
